class.name: OcgXscontrolSelectfortransfer
class.brief_description: This selection selects the entities which are recognised for transfer by an Actor for Read : current one or another one.
class.description: ! This selection selects the entities which are recognised for ! transfer by an Actor for Read : current one or another one. ! ! An Actor is an operator which runs transfers from interface ! entities to objects for Imagine. It has a method to recognize ! the entities it can process (by default, it recognises all, ! this method can be redefined). ! ! A TransferReader brings an Actor, according to the currently ! selected norm and transfer conditions. ! ! This selection considers, either the current Actor (brought by ! the TransferReader, updated as required), or a precise one.

method.name: default
method.description: Creates a SelectForTransfer, non initialised it sorts nothing, unless an Actor has been defined

method.name: from_2
method.description: Creates a SelectForTransfer, which will work with the currently defined Actor brought by the TransferReader

method.name: SetReader
method.description: Sets a TransferReader to sort entities : it brings the Actor, which may change, while the TransferReader does not

method.name: SetActor
method.description: Sets a precise actor to sort entities This definition oversedes the creation with a TransferReader

method.name: Actor
method.description: Returns the Actor used as precised one. Returns a Null Handle for a creation from a TransferReader without any further setting

method.name: Reader
method.description: Returns the Reader (if created with a Reader) Returns a Null Handle if not created with a Reader

method.name: Sort
method.description: Returns True for an Entity which is recognized by the Actor, either the precised one, or the one defined by TransferReader
